name: VoxClaude
author: hydrox
description: Hold a key, say what you want, and Claude Code does it in the background. A terminal opens only when you ask for one or Claude needs you.

barWidget.description: Status of voice-launched Claude Code sessions, with a list of recent ones to reattach.

schema.label: Permission mode
schema.description: Passed to claude --permission-mode. Anything that would prompt opens a terminal attached to the session.

schema.label: Terminal trigger words
schema.description: Comma-separated words. Say one of them and a terminal opens on the session from the start; it still runs in the background.

schema.label: Transcriber
schema.description: Who turns speech into the prompt. voxtype needs its daemon running; superwhisper records with pw-record and hands the file to the Superwhisper daemon, which never types it anywhere; apple uses apple-dictation (Apple's speech recognition on the Mac host) without typing.

schema.label: Recording pill position
schema.description: Where Superwhisper's recording pill shows while Super+D records (superwhisper transcriber only): centred on the focused window, as Superwhisper does, or at the bottom centre of the screen.
